items.title: Customizing Privacy and Security Settings for Online Platforms

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Customizing Privacy and Security Settings for Online Platforms under 9.1 as printed (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Most online platforms allow users to change their privacy and security settings based on their comfort level. These settings can control who sees your posts, who can contact you, and how data is used. Turning on features like two-factor authentication and limiting app permissions increases safety. The user should regularly review and update their settings as platforms often change their privacy rules. Customizing these options gives users more control over their digital presence and protection. For example, on WhatsApp, users can choose who can see their profile photo, such as everyone, only contacts, or nobody. They can also disable read receipts, commonly known as blue ticks, so that others cannot see whether their messages have been read.
